---
title: "Installing COSMIC on Omarchy"
status: mature
---

Install the COSMIC desktop environment alongside Omarchy/Hyprland and select it from SDDM.

::: {.callout-warning}
Desktop and login-manager changes can leave you without a graphical session if something goes wrong. Back up relevant configuration first.
:::

## disable autologin

To choose between Hyprland and COSMIC at login, disable Omarchy's SDDM autologin first.

See [Configuring SDDM on Omarchy](sddm.qmd#disable-autologin).

## install COSMIC

```bash
sudo pacman -Syu
sudo pacman -S cosmic --ignore cosmic-initial-setup
```

The `--ignore cosmic-initial-setup` flag was needed on this setup because the Omarchy mirror returned a 404 for that package. If the package is available normally, install COSMIC without the ignore flag.

Restart SDDM:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart sddm
```

At the SDDM login screen, use the session selector to choose COSMIC, then log in normally.

## session-exit issue

On this setup:

```bash
hyprctl dispatch exit
```

sometimes produced a black screen. Restarting SDDM worked as a fallback:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart sddm
```

The SDDM-specific details are kept in [Configuring SDDM on Omarchy](sddm.qmd).
